## Pull request overview

Adds first-class object association for UI actions in the spec, so actions can be returned/consumed as part of `ObjectSchema.actions` (instead of requiring downstream manual merges).

**Changes:**
- Added optional `objectName` to `ActionSchema` and optional `actions` to `ObjectSchema`.
- Implemented an auto-merge step in `defineStack()` (strict + non-strict) and `composeStacks()` to inject top-level actions into their target object’s `actions`.
- Added/updated tests and example apps to demonstrate `objectName` usage, plus a changeset for a minor release.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts | Adds `objectName` to action metadata. |
| packages/spec/src/ui/action.test.ts | Tests parsing/validation behavior for `objectName`. |
| packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts | Adds `actions?: Action[]` to objects (object-scoped actions). |
| packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts | Cross-ref validation for `action.objectName`; introduces `mergeActionsIntoObjects()` and applies it in `defineStack()`/`composeStacks()`. |
| packages/spec/src/stack.test.ts | Tests action→object auto-merge behavior in `defineStack()`. |
| packages/spec/src/compose-stacks.test.ts | Tests action→object merge across composed stacks. |
| examples/app-todo/src/actions/task.actions.ts | Adds `objectName: 'task'` to Todo task actions (including `export_csv`). |
| examples/app-crm/src/actions/opportunity.actions.ts | Adds `objectName` to opportunity actions. |
| examples/app-crm/src/actions/lead.actions.ts | Adds `objectName` to lead actions. |
| examples/app-crm/src/actions/contact.actions.ts | Adds `objectName` to contact actions. |
| examples/app-crm/src/actions/case.actions.ts | Adds `objectName` to case actions. |
| .changeset/action-object-merge.md | Declares a minor bump for the new action/object association + merge behavior. |
</details>

`objectName` validation uses a bare regex with no custom error message, so failures will produce Zod’s generic “Invalid” output. Consider reusing an existing identifier schema (or at least providing a `message` in the regex options) so consumers get a clear snake_case/object-name error similar to `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema`.
```suggestion
  objectName: SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema.optional().describe('Target object this action belongs to. When set, the action is auto-merged into the object\'s actions array by defineStack().'),
```

This example marks `export_csv` with `objectName: 'task'`, but the PR description says `export_csv` is intentionally kept as a global action example (no `objectName`). Either remove `objectName` here to keep it global, or update the PR description to reflect that the Todo export action is object-scoped.
